fileEgressPage.title: File Egress (DLP)
fileEgressPage.subtitle: Monitor files leaving devices — copied to USB or network shares, and uploaded via apps or the browser.

policiesList.empty: No file-egress policies yet. Create one to start monitoring.
policiesList.partnerWideTitle: Partner-wide policy — applies to all your organizations

policyForm.name: Name
policyForm.enabledHint: When off, agents assigned this policy do not monitor.
policyForm.watchUploadsHint: Detect a process reading a file then uploading it (Messenger, Zalo, browser). This is a correlation heuristic — it names the file, app, and destination, not proof of the exact content sent.
policyForm.uploadWatchlistHint: Process names to watch for uploads. Leave empty to use the built-in default (browsers and common chat apps).
policyForm.ignoreGlobsHint: Paths or globs to skip, e.g. *.tmp or a temp folder name.
policyForm.minFileSizeHint: Ignore files smaller than this. 0 = report all.
policyForm.deleteConfirm: Delete this policy? This cannot be undone.

eventsTable.empty: No egress events in this range.
